tokyo_plant_more_plant_more.price_note: PLANT MORE PUBLISHES BOTH ITS FULL CARD AND A 28-ALLERGEN ITEM-BY-ITEM CHART AS PDFs ON ITS OWN SITE (menu dated 2026-07-08, chart 2026-07-08 with a 2026-07-15 seasonal supplement), so every 小麦 and 乳 call below is the shop's own, not an inference. Prices are 税抜 on the card with 税込 in brackets; the 税込 figure is quoted here. Weekday 11:00-15:00 the four meal plates are sold as a 1-drink-1-food lunch set at the same price. ⚠ THE BIG TRAP IS THE OAT MILK LATTE. オーツミルクラテ (¥715) is the only coffee on the chart carrying 小麦 — the shop labels its own oat milk as wheat-containing, which is exactly the oat-crop contamination a coeliac has to worry about. The plain カフェラテ carries 乳 instead, so between them there is no latte that is both dairy-free and wheat-free; black コーヒー and デカフェ carry nothing at all. ⚠ THE SECOND TRAP IS THAT PLANT-BASED AND GLUTEN-FREE ARE DIFFERENT MARKS HERE. The sprout symbol on the card means 植物性由来原料のみ使用 and nothing about wheat: the two sprouted meal plates ('plant more' and ラザニア) both carry 小麦 (couscous, pita, lasagne sheets), while the un-sprouted チキンケバブ plate carries 乳 and 鶏肉. ⚠ CONVERSELY, the shop's own chart clears four wheat columns that a coeliac would never guess: アボカド＆スーパーグリーンサラダ, アールグレイティーケーキ, ティラミス and every soft serve and sundae are listed with NO 小麦 — the cakes are almond/soy builds, and the soft serve is almond milk. The チーズケーキ and all three マフィン do carry 小麦, so the vegan-cake case is not uniform. ⚠ Cafe Company's own header states that cooking equipment, tableware and FRYER OIL are shared and that unintended allergen carry-over is possible, so the potato fries — clear of 小麦 on the chart — are recorded as ask rather than gf.

tokyo_taishu_izakaya_toriichiz.price_note: Prices are the chain's own 税込 figures from toriichizu.net/food, linked directly from the Suidōbashi branch page (神田三崎町2-10-10 後楽ビル1F, JR Suidōbashi 2 min); the branch page's own quoted figures — 生搾りレモンサワー 109円 and the 2,200円 2-hour course — match the chain card, so the branch is not running a separate price list. ⚠ Note the チャージ料 462円 per person the branch page states up front. ⚠ GLUTEN: this is a yakitori and mizutaki izakaya and almost nothing here is safe. The tare, the ponzu, the 特製味噌, the 揚げ出し豆腐 coating, the からあげ and the 串カツ are all wheat, the 〆のラーメン is a wheat noodle and both パイタン麺 bowls are wheat ramen, and the fryer is shared across every potato and every karaage. The chain does publish a 使用しているアレルギー物質 chart at toriichizu.net/allergen — but the image the page embeds (wp-content/uploads/2026/02/アレルギー.png) 404s at every srcset size from this egress, so no item-level allergen call could be read; ask in the shop for the printed version. Diet flags below are therefore conservative inference from the dish, not from that chart.

tokyo_men_iroiro_itsudemo_oyat.price_note: Transcribed from the shop's own menu book PDF, linked from the DD Group page for the Lumine Est Shinjuku 7F branch and dated 2026-04-20 in its filename. The card prints 税抜 first with 税込 in brackets; the 税込 figure is quoted here. ⚠ EVERY UDON ON THIS MENU IS A SET: the price includes お好きなうどん, a small-dishes selection (えらべるおやつ) and the ドリンクビュッフェ drink bar; めんの大盛り is +¥250. ⚠ THIS IS NOT A GLUTEN-FREE COLOURED-NOODLE SHOP, whatever the rainbow of noodles suggests. The base noodle is 全粒粉のめん — the shop's own text reads 小麦の表皮、胚芽、胚乳を全て粉にした, i.e. wholemeal WHEAT — and the four choosable coloured noodles (spinach, yuzu, black sesame, pumpkin, +¥250) are introduced as 小麦粉と相性の良い野菜や穀物などを練り合わせた, i.e. vegetables kneaded INTO wheat flour. Nothing on the noodle side of this menu is wheat-free. ⚠ The cold お出汁 bowls are built on a Japanese dashi broth, which is both a bonito and a wheat-soy fact, and the curry udon, the tonkatsu and the 鶏天 are wheat again on top of the noodle. The card's own line is 食物アレルギーがご心配のお客様は、当店スタッフにお申し出ください — there is no published allergen chart, so the flags below are conservative inference from the dish.

tokyo_katsukichi_suido_bashi_t.price_note: From the shop's own site (文京区本郷1-4-1 全水道会館ビルB1, matching the record's Suidobashi/Hongo placement). ⚠ PRICE DISCREPANCY ON THE SHOP'S OWN SITE — the structured menu tab prices ひれかつ定食 at ¥2,800/120g and ¥3,000/150g, while the おすすめ料理 promo block on the same site's front page still prints ¥2,400/¥2,600/¥3,100. The prices below are the structured menu tab, which is the list the shop maintains as its card; the promo block reads as stale copy left over from an earlier price. Expect the higher figure. A second internal inconsistency: 豚手ごねかつ定食 is listed at ¥2,300 for 130g and ¥2,200 for 160g, i.e. the larger portion is cheaper — that is a typo on the shop's page, not a bargain. ⚠ THIS IS A TONKATSU HOUSE AND IT IS EXHAUSTIVELY WHEAT. The shop describes its own method in detail and every detail is a gluten fact: the cutlets are 「最高級の生パン粉で包み」 — wrapped in top-grade FRESH panko, which is wheat bread — and deep-fried in a corn-and-sesame oil blend that every crumbed item on the card goes through. There is no non-crumbed main. ⚠ THE ONE PIECE OF GOOD NEWS IS THE SOUP AND IT IS NARROW: the sets come with 八丁味噌の赤出汁, and Hatcho miso is a pure soybean-and-koji miso with no barley and no wheat in it, unlike the 麦味噌 that would be the danger at a Kyushu shop. That says nothing about the dashi it is made with, which is bonito and normally carries a soy-based seasoning. Sets also include a choice of plain rice or 青しそご飯, salad and pickles. ⚠ Nothing here is vegan. The 豚しゃぶ鍋 is the only main that is not crumbed and it is pork in a dashi pot.

tokyo_vegetus_plus.price_note: From the shop's own site. Address confirmed as 千代田区神田三崎町3-1-8 天野ビル1F, six minutes from JR Suidobashi west exit — the record's placement. Open Mon–Fri and days before public holidays 11:00–15:00, 「売り切れ次第終了」 (closes when sold out); closed Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. So this is a weekday-lunch-only shop, which the record does not say and which matters more than any dish here for anyone planning a visit. ⚠ THE RECORD DESCRIBES THIS SHOP AS 「有機野菜・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー対応」 AND THE SHOP'S OWN SITE SUPPORTS ONLY THE FIRST THIRD OF THAT. Across all five of its pages Vegetus+ makes NO gluten-free claim, NO vegetarian claim and NO vegan claim — the words do not appear. Its About Us page argues the OPPOSITE case at length and in its own voice: 「『ヘルシーな食事＝野菜だけの食事』という訳ではありませんでした」, that plant and animal amino acids differ so you need both, and that B12 and vitamin D are very hard to get from vegetables alone. The name is branding, not a dietary claim. The current deli list bears that out — pork fillet, chicken thigh, mackerel, octopus, scallop and beef bulgogi all appear on it. A traveller sent here expecting a vegetarian or gluten-free restaurant will find a healthy-eating deli that explicitly is not one. This needs a human's eyes on the record's cuisine field. ⚠ THE GLUTEN RISK THE SHOP DOES DOCUMENT IS ITS RICE. Vegetus+ states it serves an 「オリジナル雑穀米」 — a house multigrain blend chosen for vitamins and fibre. Japanese 雑穀米 blends routinely include 押麦 or もち麦, which is BARLEY, and barley is not on Japan's statutory allergen list so no label will disclose it. The blend's composition is not published. That is the first question to ask here. ⚠ WHAT THE SHOP DOES DOCUMENT IS GOOD AND UNUSUAL: oils are 「機械搾りの菜種油とエキストラバージンオリーブオイル のみ」 — mechanically pressed rapeseed and EVOO only, no solvent-extracted oils; salt is Italian natural salt and sugar is kibi-tou; everything is made in-house with 「保存料など不必要な添加物や化学調味料を使わず」, no preservatives or MSG; vegetables are organic or low-pesticide where supply allows. The green salad is stated to be five or more leaf varieties. ⚠ THE DELI LIST BELOW ROTATES: the shop states one deli changes every week and directs you to its Instagram or UberEats for the current line-up, warning that UberEats portions and prices differ from the in-store takeaway ones. Treat the eleven delis below as a dated snapshot of one week, not a fixed card. ⚠ Two of the four salad dressings are dairy — バルサミコチーズ and ヨーグルト — leaving apple and carrot as the plant options. The SINGLE MENU and ORGANIC DRINK sections of the menu page are image blocks that currently render empty, so no single items or drinks could be read.
